fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Paint looks clean and fairly glossy overall in bright sun on the sides and hood
Corrosion or pitting showing on the chrome LIMITED badge letters on the liftgate (visible on the D)
Slightly grayish black lower bumper and cladding on the rear bumper and rocker trim
Light dust and grime on the lower door panels and rear bumper area
No interior photos to judge the cabin
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the white Explorer Limited and it already looks sharp. The black lower trim on the rear bumper and rockers is starting to look a little gray, and a fresh wash and wax would make that pearl white pop in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, inside and out, and come to you. Would you like a quote?
